issues.problem: Literal rightward original label/mask index movement contradicts Y=targets[1:] and the concrete7→6 first-answer mapping. Adjacent7.4 explicitly explains the previous predictor slot. Official TRL prose also has ambiguous wording; actual official source and course code fix the numeric direction.
issues.evidence: Original full IDs place first answer239 at7 and assistant4 at6. Actual valid Y positions6–9 correspond to original answers7–10; original fence and independent probe agree. Transformers official v4.57.1 lines1279–1280 compare logits[:-1] with labels[1:].
issues.impact: A reader implementing the described right shift can misplace assistant target and role mask or shift twice, changing which next-token predictions receive supervision.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the two right-shift phrases with explicit next-element/previous-predictor-slot wording, e.g. 每格的目標取原序列的下一項，答案與mask一起配到前一格的預測位置 and 對齊下一項的label.
